state: You fixed a setup problem on this machine (a missing Defender exclusion list for the repo).
Two other machines, the Lenovo and the NUC, have the same problem.
mts_signal.py broadcast --cmd sends a command that each host's session runs and acks.
pass_if: The reply puts the fix in the repo (a script or doc) and sends the per-machine step with mts_signal.py broadcast --cmd.
The reply does not ask the operator to repeat the step on the other machines.
fail_if: The reply tells the operator to run the same step by hand on each machine.
The reply fixes only this machine and says nothing about the others.
source: 2026-10-25: Fleet-wide principle in CLAUDE.md: what one machine needs, all need; repo plus broadcast --cmd, never operator repetition.
